title: Random Feature Neural Networks for Stochastic Optimal Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.30804v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Random feature neural networks (RFNNs) sample their hidden parameters once and train only the output layer. We analyze RFNNs as feedback policies for finite-horizon stochastic control with trajectory-dependent objectives. A policy change alters later states, so the error that matters is the objective error of the induced trajectory rather than a pointwise regression error. We extend the quantitative random-feature approximation theory for PDE solutions and nonlinear regression to feedback control. We investigate the objective error of an RFNN policy through two sources, approximation of the policy by random features and estimation of the objective from finitely many paths. A stability estimate for the controlled trajectory turns a policy error into an objective error. Under bounded actions, a regular benchmark policy and exact empirical minimization, the expected objective gap to the benchmark policy is at most of order $N^{-1/2}+\sqrt

translated_title: 随机最优控制的随机特征神经网络
translated_abstract: 随机特征神经网络（RFNN）只需对隐层参数进行一次采样，之后仅训练输出层。我们将RFNN作为具有轨迹依赖目标的有限时域随机控制的反馈策略进行分析。由于策略的改变会影响后续状态，因此真正重要的误差是由该策略所诱导轨迹的目标误差，而非逐点回归误差。我们将针对偏微分方程解和非线性回归的定量随机特征逼近理论扩展到反馈控制领域。我们从两个来源研究RFNN策略的目标误差：随机特征对策略的逼近误差，以及从有限条路径估计目标所产生的误差。受控轨迹的稳定性估计将策略误差转化为目标误差。在有界动作、正则的基准策略以及精确经验最小化的条件下，相对于基准策略的期望目标差距至多为 $N^{-1/2}+\sqrt{\cdots}$ 的阶。
tldr: 本文将随机特征神经网络作为有限时域随机控制的反馈策略进行理论分析，证明了在有界动作和正则基准策略条件下，其相对于基准策略的期望目标误差至多为 $N^{-1/2}$ 阶（加上有限路径带来的统计估计误差）。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes random feature neural networks (RFNNs) as feedback policies for finite-horizon stochastic control, proving that under bounded actions and a regular benchmark policy, the expected objective gap to the benchmark is at most of order $N^{-1/2}$ (plus statistical estimation error from finitely many paths).
